title: MTU / fragmentation: a path-MTU black hole
symptom: Ping works, the port is open, the request is accepted and the response headers arrive. Then the download hangs forever.
fault: The link between routers r1 and r2 has an MTU of 1000 bytes, and both routers drop the ICMP 'fragmentation needed' errors (type 3, code 4) that path-MTU discovery relies on.
